# Diana

[Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)

## Overview

- **Age:** eighteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v3 ch.Change P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>  
  _previously: 13 (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (relative), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) (relative), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty girl with rosy or crimson cheeks, dimples, and a slightly plump build. Her hair is characterized variously as glossy, jet-black tresses, black curls, and red hair. She has black eyes, as well as gray-green eyes that shine with a peculiar brilliance in the dusk.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P5](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0005), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), +1 more_

## Personality

Diana is described as good, smart, and practical, possessing an unselfish admiration for the talents and graces of her friends. She is skilled in culinary matters, notably at making splendid lettuce salad. Additionally, she has earned a reputation for her taste in dressing, making her advice on the subject much sought after.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P25](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0025), [v3 ch.Atonement” P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Diana was named by a schoolmaster who boarded at her home when she was born, and as a girl in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she learned fancy crochet stitches from her aunt in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), imagined ghosts in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), helped form a schoolgirl story club, and swore a solemn oath of eternal friendship with [Anne](../character/anne.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). During their schooldays, Diana accidentally became intoxicated at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after drinking currant wine that [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistook for raspberry cordial, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to temporarily forbid the girls from playing together. Their friendship was restored after [Anne](../character/anne.md) heroically saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup while their parents were away. Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) later accidentally jumped onto [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) [Barry](../character/barry.md) in a spare-room bed during a sleepover, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) managed to appease the angry aunt, securing Diana's continued music lessons. Diana later received a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), helped launch the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), and went on a festive trip to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) with [Anne](../character/anne.md). When [Anne](../character/anne.md) took the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams, Diana brought the published results to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to announce Anne's first-place tie, and she later attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) news while remaining in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Along with [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), Diana unsuccessfully attempted to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to remove patent medicine ads from his fences, and she later accidentally got lost in the woods with [Anne](../character/anne.md), leading them to meet Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Diana became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), and prior to her wedding, she secretly edited and submitted Anne's rejected manuscript to a baking powder contest, winning a prize for her friend. Following her wedding to [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), Diana settled into married life as a matron and eventually welcomed a baby, continuing her lifelong, unshakeable bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md) through all of life's transitions.

## Quotes

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “The nicest I ever drank,” said Diana. “It’s ever so much nicer than Mrs. Lynde’s, although she brags of hers so much. It doesn’t taste a bit like hers.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) formed an immediate, deeply affectionate friendship as young schoolmates walking to school together and exchanging secret notes. Their bond faced early trials, such as an incident where Diana accidentally became intoxicated on currant wine at tea, leading her mother to temporarily forbid them from playing together. Their friendship was restored after [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's baby sister from croup, and they have remained devotionally attached companions through concerts, games, and academic milestone celebrations.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +47 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Diana's closest childhood chum, with whom she shares constant play, story clubs, and dramatic games. Though their friendship suffered a brief separation due to a misunderstanding over homemade wine, Diana remained steadfastly loyal, slipping [Anne](../character/anne.md) secret notes of devotion until they reconciled. Over the years, Diana has stood by [Anne](../character/anne.md) through school exams, grief, and quiet afternoon teas, viewing her as an irreplaceable lifelong confidante.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), +15 more</sub>

### [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) is Diana's formidable great-aunt, whose initial stay at the [Barry](../character/barry.md) house was thrown into turmoil when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally leaped onto her in a spare-room bed. Despite this disastrous start, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) grew fond of the girls, sending kid slippers to [Anne](../character/anne.md) for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) and extending an invitation for both Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to visit her grand estate, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
